mapper.select:
select from biz_project_proposal p left join sys_dept company on company.dept_id=p.company_dept_id and company.del_flag='0' left join biz_project parent on parent.project_id=p.parent_project_id and parent.del_flag='0' where p.del_flag='0' and p.sponsor_owner_user_id=#{userId} and p.status=#{status} and p.status='PENDING'
and (p.project_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or p.applicant_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
order by p.submitted_time,p.proposal_id

select p.proposal_id,p.proposal_no,p.project_name,p.applicant_user_id,p.applicant_name, p.sponsor_owner_user_id,p.sponsor_owner_name,p.status,p.create_time,p.update_time,p.del_flag from biz_project_proposal p where p.del_flag='0'
and (p.project_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or p.applicant_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
order by p.create_time desc,p.proposal_id desc

select from biz_project_proposal p left join sys_dept company on company.dept_id=p.company_dept_id and company.del_flag='0' left join biz_project parent on parent.project_id=p.parent_project_id and parent.del_flag='0' where p.proposal_id=#{proposalId} and p.del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update biz_project_proposal set project_name=#{projectName},sponsor_owner_user_id=#{sponsorOwnerUserId}, sponsor_owner_name=#{sponsorOwnerName},company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId},parent_project_id=#{parentProjectId}, project_type=#{projectType},accounting_mode=#{accountingMode},management_mode=#{managementMode}, objective=#{objective},application_reason=#{applicationReason},plan_start_date=#{planStartDate}, plan_end_date=#{planEndDate},priority=#{priority},base_currency=#{baseCurrency},budget_limit=#{budgetLimit}, no_budget=#{noBudget},execution_source=#{executionSource},review_comment=null,reviewed_user_id=null, reviewed_user_name=null,reviewed_time=null,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1,remark=#{remark} where proposal_id=#{proposalId} and applicant_user_id=#{applicantUserId} and del_flag='0' and status in ('DRAFT','RETURNED','WITHDRAWN') and version=#{version}
mapper.select: select event_id eventId,proposal_id proposalId,submission_version submissionVersion,event_type eventType, from_status fromStatus,to_status toStatus,operator_user_id operatorUserId,operator_name operatorName, event_comment comment,create_time createTime from biz_project_proposal_event where proposal_id=#{proposalId} order by event_id desc

select u.user_id userId,u.user_name userName,u.nick_name nickName,u.dept_id deptId from sys_user u left join biz_staff_profile profile on profile.user_id=u.user_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' and coalesce(profile.employment_status,'ACTIVE')<>'LEFT' limit 1

select u.user_id userId,u.user_name userName,u.nick_name nickName from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.role_key='company_owner' and r.del_flag='0' and r.status='0' left join biz_staff_profile profile on profile.user_id=u.user_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' and coalesce(profile.employment_status,'ACTIVE')<>'LEFT' limit 1
select dept_id deptId,dept_name deptName from sys_dept where dept_id=#{deptId} and parent_id=100 and del_flag='0' and status='0' limit 1

select project_id projectId,project_name projectName, coalesce(sponsor_owner_user_id,initiator_user_id) sponsorOwnerUserId from biz_project where project_id=#{projectId} and del_flag='0' and status not in ('CLOSED','CANCELED') limit 1

select distinct u.user_id userId,u.user_name userName,u.nick_name nickName from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.role_key='company_owner' and r.del_flag='0' and r.status='0' left join biz_staff_profile profile on profile.user_id=u.user_id where u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' and coalesce(profile.employment_status,'ACTIVE')<>'LEFT' and u.user_id<>#{excludeUserId} order by u.user_id
select company.dept_id deptId,company.dept_name deptName from sys_dept company where company.parent_id=100 and company.del_flag='0' and company.status='0' order by company.order_num,company.dept_id
